### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {
  await page.bringToFront();
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const pc = await import(performance.getEntriesByType('resource').find(e => e.name.includes('/deps/playcanvas.js')).name);
    const app = pc.Application.getApplication();
    const actors = { npc: app.root.findByName('Cleric greeting prototype'), user: app.root.findByName('Visitor') };
    const samples = [];
    let frame;
    const joints = actor => {
      const inv = actor.getWorldTransform().clone().invert();
      const position = name => inv.transformPoint(actor.findByName(name).getPosition());
      const waist = position('Abdomen'), torso = position('Torso').sub(waist);
      return {
        lean: Math.atan2(torso.z, torso.y) * 180 / Math.PI,
        hips: position('Hips').toArray(), feet: position('Foot.L').toArray(),
        wrists: position('Wrist.L').distance(position('Wrist.R')),
      };
    };
    const before = () => {
      const state = window.atlasCharacter.snapshot().greeting;
      frame = { state, posed: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(actors).map(([key, actor]) => [key, joints(actor)])) };
    };
    const after = () => {
      if (!frame) return;
      for (const [key, actor] of Object.entries(actors)) {
        const idle = joints(actor), posed = frame.posed[key];
        posed.actualBow = posed.lean - idle.lean;
        posed.hipsShift = Math.hypot(...posed.hips.map((x, i) => x - idle.hips[i]));
        posed.feetShift = Math.hypot(...posed.feet.map((x, i) => x - idle.feet[i]));
      }
      samples.push(frame); frame = null;
    };
    app.on('prerender', before); app.on('postrender', after);
    window.__bowTest = { samples, cleanup: () => { app.off('prerender', before); app.off('postrender', after); } };
  });
  try {
    await page.keyboard.press('KeyR');
    await page.waitForTimeout(250);
    await page.keyboard.down('KeyW');
    try { await page.waitForTimeout(650); } finally { await page.keyboard.up('KeyW'); }
    await page.waitForTimeout(50);
    await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');
    await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
    const result = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const samples = window.__bowTest.samples;
      const summarize = key => {
        const active = samples.filter(s => s.state[`${key}Remaining`] > 0);
        const peak = active.filter(s => s.state[`${key}BowDegrees`] === 15);
        const upright = active.filter(s => s.state[`${key}Weight`] === 1 && s.state[`${key}BowDegrees`] === 0);
        const lowering = active.filter(s => s.state[`${key}Remaining`] < 0.5 && s.state[`${key}Weight`] < 1);
        return {
          activeFrames: active.length, peakFrames: peak.length, uprightHandsJoinedFrames: upright.length, loweringFrames: lowering.length,
          peakActualBow: peak.map(s => s.posed[key].actualBow),
          peakWristSeparation: peak.map(s => s.posed[key].wrists),
          maxAngleError: Math.max(...active.map(s => Math.abs(s.posed[key].actualBow - s.state[`${key}BowDegrees`]))),
          maxHipsShift: Math.max(...active.map(s => s.posed[key].hipsShift)),
          maxFeetShift: Math.max(...active.map(s => s.posed[key].feetShift)),
          loweringOnlyUpright: lowering.every(s => s.state[`${key}BowDegrees`] === 0 && Math.abs(s.posed[key].actualBow) < 0.01),
          straighteningKeepsHandsJoined: active.filter(s => s.state[`${key}Remaining`] < 1.3 && s.state[`${key}BowDegrees`] > 0).every(s => s.state[`${key}Weight`] === 1),
        };
      };
      return { npc: summarize('npc'), user: summarize('user'), samples };
    });
    // Freeze an actual live peak pose to inspect hand/chest/waist together.
    await page.keyboard.press('KeyR');
    await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const pc = await import(performance.getEntriesByType('resource').find(e => e.name.includes('/deps/playcanvas.js')).name);
      const app = pc.Application.getApplication(), npc = app.root.findByName('Cleric greeting prototype');
      const camera = app.root.findComponents('camera').find(c => c.enabled && c.entity.enabled).entity;
      const original = { position: camera.getPosition().clone(), rotation: camera.getRotation().clone(), fov: camera.camera.fov, timeScale: app.timeScale };
      const review = { frozen: false, angle: null };
      const view = () => {
        const state = window.atlasCharacter.snapshot().greeting;
        if (!review.frozen && state.npcBowDegrees === 15 && state.userBowDegrees === 15) { app.timeScale = 0; review.frozen = true; }
        if (review.angle === null) return;
        const point = (x, y, z) => npc.getWorldTransform().transformPoint(new pc.Vec3(x, y, z));
        camera.setPosition(point(Math.sin(review.angle) * 1.8, 1.1, Math.cos(review.angle) * 1.8));
        camera.lookAt(point(0, 1, 0.13)); camera.camera.fov = 60;
      };
      app.on('prerender', view);
      window.__bowView = { review, cleanup: () => { app.off('prerender', view); app.timeScale = original.timeScale; camera.camera.fov = original.fov; camera.setPosition(original.position); camera.setRotation(original.rotation); } };
    });
    await page.keyboard.down('KeyW');
    try { await page.waitForTimeout(650); } finally { await page.keyboard.up('KeyW'); }
    await page.waitForTimeout(50);
    await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');
    await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__bowView.review.frozen, { timeout: 5000 });
    await page.screenshot({ path: 'output/playwright/steps/greeting-bow-full.png' });
    await page.evaluate(() => window.__bowView.review.angle = 0);
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    await page.screenshot({ path: 'output/playwright/steps/greeting-bow-front.png' });
    await page.evaluate(() => window.__bowView.review.angle = Math.PI / 2);
    await page.waitForTimeout(100);
    await page.screenshot({ path: 'output/playwright/steps/greeting-bow-side.png' });
    return result;
  } finally {
    await page.evaluate(() => { window.__bowTest?.cleanup(); window.__bowView?.cleanup(); delete window.__bowTest; delete window.__bowView; });
  }
})(page);
```
